description: The chosen language as tokens and a component library written in RCSS, shown on a component board in the viewer with every state (hover, pressed, disabled, selected, focus-visible). Lint: tokens only, library classes, dp only, minimum text 14 dp, contrast; the board renders at the D19 corners (1080p x 85 %, 4K x 125 %, 21:9, 16:10) with no clipping. A library change re-renders and reports what changed. Liam plays the board and locks it.
title: Design tokens and component library in RCSS
